notes: Fixed: Breezy could open off the screen, to the left of the main monitor, when the mouse was on the second monitor as it started - also after an update. Breezy now opens where it was last (same monitor, place and size, maximized again if it was). If that monitor is gone or Breezy doesn't fit on it, it opens in the middle of the main monitor, and a window that still ends up off every screen is brought back at once.
Settings > General > Window > 'Breezy opens': where it was last (default) or always on the main monitor.
